description: Port forwarding rule caused proxy loop — all outbound connections blocked
root_cause: netsh portproxy rule created during troubleshooting, never cleaned up. Kernel-level forwarding consumed all port 7890 connections while proxy app received none.
resolution: Deleted stale portproxy rule + deployed automated cleanup cron
encoded_rule: Any portproxy operation MUST include cleanup logic. Automated guard scans every 5 minutes.

description: Agent delivered broken URL to supervisor — link 404'd on delivery
root_cause: URL was constructed from stale memory, not verified against live source before delivery
resolution: Added URL format validation gate + cross-reference check
encoded_rule: Any URL in agent output MUST be validated before delivery (format check + reachable check)

description: Syncthing process zombie — systemd restart loop exhausted all retries, service dead
root_cause: Forked child process held lock/kernel ports after parent SIGTERM. systemd KillMode=control-group only killed parent.
resolution: Changed to KillMode=mixed + ExecStopPost cleanup. Service auto-recovers without human intervention.
encoded_rule: Systemd services for stateful agent processes MUST use KillMode=mixed + explicit cleanup

description: Complete self-heal chain: Watchdog detected failure → auto-diagnosis → remediation → verification → constraint generation
resolution: Three-tier autonomous recovery: Watchdog detection → L1 auto-fix → L2 escalation → L3 founder alert
encoded_rule: Every infrastructure component MUST have a self-heal chain with defined escalation path
